stories.title: Adopt Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract (Align with Brain)
stories.description: Align FindCare audit logging with the existing Brain audit schema and append-only contract (BRAIN-F-004-S1), mapping debug_logger fields to standardized fields (timestamp, actor, action_type, tool_name, payload metadata, correlation_id, hash fields) and enforcing insert-only behavior at the repository layer.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; ASSUMPTION: Existing Brain audit schema (BRAIN-F-004-S1) is source of truth and must be reused to avoid duplication; GAP: schema mapping definition not yet implemented

stories.title: Append-Only Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Extend debug_logger into a reusable backend audit component that generates immutable records with deterministic hash chaining (previous_hash → current_hash), ensuring tamper-evident sequencing and atomic insert-only writes.

stories.title: FindCare Tooling and Service Audit Instrumentation
stories.description: Instrument backend components (tool_router, safety_service, provider_search_service, clinical_trials_service) to emit structured audit events for tool calls, external API usage, and safety triggers, ensuring correlation_id continuity within a single request lifecycle.

stories.title: Internal Audit Log Query Interface (Backend Only)
stories.description: Provide a backend-only read interface for audit logs supporting queries by correlation_id, time range, and action_type, with optional hash-chain verification for integrity validation. No external or Brain API exposure.
stories.evidence: GAP: debug_logger supports writes only; no read/query interface exists

stories.title: Audit Logging Tests: Append-Only and Integrity Validation
stories.description: Expand test_debug_logger to cover append-only enforcement, hash chain continuity, event coverage across tool flows, and simulated tampering detection (e.g., missing or altered records). Include integration tests from tool_router through persistence.
